<thought>Based on the six resistance measurements between the four nodes (B, Nc1, Nc2, X2) and knowing there are only three resistors, the network must be a tree (no loops). The only configuration that satisfies all measured pairwise resistances is a series chain: B‑20Ω‑Nc2‑15Ω‑Nc1‑10Ω‑X2. Assigning the resistors left‑to‑right (from X2 toward B) gives R1=10 Ω (X2‑Nc1), R2=15 Ω (Nc1‑Nc2), R3=20 Ω (Nc2‑B). This topology reproduces every given measurement, so it is the identified subnetwork 3. </thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 10, "R2": 15, "R3": 20}, "connections": [["X2","Nc1","R1"], ["Nc1","Nc2","R2"], ["Nc2","B","R3"]]}</final_answer>
